answerPolicyA: every BLOCKING question answered with: the option the tool marks as its leaning; else the option it costs until answered; else (route only) the route the server is already costing as placeholder; else the first option offered. Advisory questions left at the tool's costed default. Route-matched "@sheet" variants: the route is a stated engineering assumption (sheet_metal) in BOTH A and C.
reviewPolicyC: from the independent truth file: a drawing reading equal to a truth row (scorer rowAccepts) is confirmed; a scalar reading whose parameter the truth gives ONE value for is corrected to it; any other reading in a group the truth lists as complete is rejected (not on the drawing); readings in groups the truth does not list completely are left unreviewed; an interpreted value is confirmed once its source is confirmed/corrected (checked by hand: one stale interpretation rejected, see manual-review.json); conflicts settled to the side equal to the truth. Other blocking questions answered as in A (same id) unless the drawing answers them. Note: on the screen only readings outside the "not in the cost model" list can be decided — the API accepts decisions on all.
